Box

A generic container component for applying padding, margin, borders, shadows, backgrounds, and sizing utilities.

Basic Box

Use .zak-box as a simple container with default padding.

This is a basic .zak-box with default padding
HTML
<div class="zak-box">
  Basic box content
</div>

Box Padding

Control padding with size modifiers from .zak-box-sm to .zak-box-xl.

box-sm
box-md
box-lg
box-xl
HTML
<div class="zak-box zak-box-sm">Small padding</div>
<div class="zak-box zak-box-md">Medium padding</div>
<div class="zak-box zak-box-lg">Large padding</div>
<div class="zak-box zak-box-xl">Extra large padding</div>

Box with Border

Add borders using .zak-box-bordered or individual border utilities.

Bordered box
Custom border
Dashed border
HTML
<div class="zak-box zak-box-bordered">Bordered</div>
<div class="zak-box" style="border: 2px solid var(--zak-primary)">Custom</div>
<div class="zak-box" style="border: 1px dashed var(--zak-secondary)">Dashed</div>

Box with Shadow

Apply shadow effects with shadow utility classes.

shadow-sm
shadow
shadow-lg
HTML
<div class="zak-box zak-shadow-sm">Small shadow</div>
<div class="zak-box zak-shadow">Default shadow</div>
<div class="zak-box zak-shadow-lg">Large shadow</div>

Box with Background

Apply background colors for visual emphasis.

Primary bg
Secondary bg
Success bg
Danger bg
HTML
<div class="zak-box" style="background: var(--zak-primary-light)">Primary</div>
<div class="zak-box" style="background: var(--zak-success-light)">Success</div>
<div class="zak-box" style="background: var(--zak-danger-light)">Danger</div>

Control width and height with sizing utilities.

Width: 75%
Width: 50%
Width: 25%
HTML
<div class="zak-box" style="width: 75%">75% width</div>
<div class="zak-box" style="width: 50%">50% width</div>

Interactive Boxes

Add hover effects and transitions for interactive elements.

Hover shadow
Hover scale
Hover opacity
HTML
<div class="zak-box zak-box-bordered zak-hover-shadow">Hover shadow</div>
<div class="zak-box zak-box-bordered zak-hover-scale">Hover scale</div>

CSS Reference

HTML
.zak-box { padding: 1rem; }
.zak-box-sm { padding: 0.5rem; }
.zak-box-md { padding: 1rem; }
.zak-box-lg { padding: 1.5rem; }
.zak-box-xl { padding: 2rem; }
.zak-box-bordered { border: 1px solid var(--zak-border); }
.zak-shadow-sm { box-shadow: var(--zak-shadow-sm); }
.zak-shadow { box-shadow: var(--zak-shadow); }
.zak-shadow-lg { box-shadow: var(--zak-shadow-lg); }

Accessibility

  • Box is a generic container — ensure semantic HTML inside for screen readers
  • Interactive boxes should have role="button" and keyboard support if they trigger actions
  • Maintain sufficient color contrast when using background colors
